about: Split answers for the validation set, given by the controller on the owner's behalf (owner, Nov 18: 'do the full 42 search validation too'; earlier: 'do what you recommend'). Each answer is what a person reading the bundle's own Home Depot page and title would choose; the note gives the evidence. Pages: fixtures/validation/pages-2026-11-18.json. Where an answer rests on another page or on reading the model number, the note says so.
